commitments.detail: Identify and document the root cause of the handoff delays.

decisions.documented_root_cause: Handoff process gap and high workload

commitments.detail: Develop and implement a detailed handoff checklist to ensure clear communication and reduce delays.
Provide training on the importance of timely client handoffs and best practices for managing concurrent client escalations.
Develop and implement a detailed handoff checklist to prevent future delays.
